mapper.select: SELECT id, family_id, user_id, role, duty FROM family_members WHERE family_id=#{familyId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM family_members WHERE family_id=#{familyId} AND user_id=#{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM family_members WHERE user_id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO family_members(family_id, user_id, role, duty) VALUES(#{familyId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{duty})
mapper.update: UPDATE family_members SET family_id=#{familyId}, user_id=#{userId}, role=#{role}, duty=#{duty} WHERE id=#{id}
